summary: Frontend E2E (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 390) of the redesigned 'Get a number' page and related clean-ups for existing account civr.uxtest@example.com. Every requested item passed: Add-to-plan card shows first, the 4 purpose cards show prices and 'You have' notes, numbered sections appear for the chosen purposes, URL params preselect the right card, header labels and links are correct, Home has no texting upsell, My numbers has a Fax numbers section (after a DRY RUN fax buy), the Wallet note text is right, and the Texting restart works with no wallet charge. Found only minor UX issues.

issues: The numbering is nested and confusing: a '1' section badge ('Voice · Business Line'), then the 1/2/3 checkout stepper, then the label '1 · FIND A NUMBER'. Three '1's in a row. Consider dropping the '1 ·/2 ·/3 ·' labels inside the section or the stepper.

Voice says 'You have 2 Business Lines' and SIP says 'You have 2 lines with SIP' because the count includes the extra/sub-number +13343334444, which hangs off +13341112222. Consider counting only main lines (!isSubNumber).
